cohort: 2,405,082 singleton births in 15 regions of Chile between 2001 and 2014
finding: Publicly insured women delivering at private institutions in Chile have a higher likelihood of cesarean delivery compared to those privately insured, contributing to the overall high and growing cesarean section rates in the country, without evidence of increased medical necessity.
mod_finding: Publicly insured women delivering at private institutions in Chile had higher rates of cesarean deliveries compared to those with private insurance.
